gloss: leaving a message on read; ignoring a read message

definitions.gloss: leaving a message on read, read-ignoring
definitions.explanation: Reading someone's message (as shown by the read receipt) but not replying. Originally associated with LINE's {既読|きどく} (read) indicator, now used broadly for any messaging app.

examples.japanese: {既読|きどく}スルー⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{既読|きどく}スルー⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。

⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{既読|きどく}スルー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: They might just be busy, but if the read-ignoring continues, it makes me anxious.

notes:
COMPONENTS: ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧ (already read) + ⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧ (through, from English "through" meaning to ignore/let pass).

Originated with the LINE messaging app, which shows ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧ next to messages that have been read. Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {既読|きどく}スルー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{未読|みどく}→未読：07733_midoku⟧⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧ — ignoring a message without even reading it
- ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく — to get a read receipt
- ⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to ignore, to let something pass

This phenomenon has become a significant source of social anxiety, especially among younger people, as it implies the recipient saw the message but deliberately chose not to respond.
